items: 【Powerful Performance】This latest 10.1-inch tablet comes with the latest Android 15 operating system with support for more applications and a 2.0 GHz octa-core processor for improved graphics performance . You will enjoy the more smooth running than Android 15 system. Perfect for watching videos, learning, video chatting and reading e-books.

【Large Storage Space】This Android tablet has 128GB ROM+24GB(8+16) RAM, 1TB additional expansion, which can store more movies, videos, music, and work software for you, and supports Netflix, Facebook, Tik Tok, Youtube, and other software, you can play more comfortably games, download and preview rich movies, and accommodate massive work files.

【New 6000mAh Battery 】The tablet is equipped with a 6000mAh long-lasting battery, which makes reading, browsing the web, watching videos and listening to music easy. It is suitable for both daily life and traveling. It is also a great companion for your entertainment and a perfect gift for all kinds of holidays and birthdays.

【Unique And Elegant Design】This Android 15 Tablet features an Ultra HD screen with 1280x800 professionally designed with the latest and unique Straight Edge Profile and Camera (5MP + 8MP) that complement each other with clarity and elegance. The body is comfortable to touch and has passed many tests for reliable quality.

【Rich Connectivity Options】 It supports Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4 to provide high-speed and stable wireless connectivity. It is also equipped with a USB-C port to support fast data transfer and charging, and is compatible with a variety of peripheral extensions to meet the needs of various usage scenarios.

【After-Sales Support】 The Raemond Android tablet comes with a 2-year warranty and 24/7 customer service support. Whether you have technical issues or setup questions, we are always ready to assist you.
